**AI Summary:** China plans to include 23 AI technologies in its export control list, according to a notice from the Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Science and Technology. The technologies, which include AI chip design and models trained on sensitive data, are among 40 technologies that will be added to the export control list. The new regulations will come into effect immediately, with a public comment period ending on November 15. The scope of AI technologies under control is described as "precise and limited," with open-source technologies and services provided via API remaining unaffected. The sources also mention the challenges and future prospects of world models, a type of AI technology that aims to understand and predict the physical world, which is seen as a key technology for achieving advanced general intelligence (AGI).
